agents.summary: Beitlab Robotics builds Balance Robot v1, a wheeled biped, and the Robotics Board v0.11, a carrier for the Milk-V Duo S (SG2000: Cortex-A53 Linux + C906 real-time core). It also shares an open SDK, duo-s-playground, so makers can flash the Duo S with Wi-Fi preconfigured and write C906 programs in plain C (FreeRTOS) or in the Arduino-style beitlabduino library.
notes: Every page below is available as Markdown at the same address with .md instead of .html. llms-full.txt contains all of them in one file. CAD, schematics, the hardware list and the engineering book are not published. Balance Robot v1 and the board are prototypes: values come from design files unless a page says it was measured.
